nodes.label: PortalGetClipInfo (0x4638D0)
nodes.rationale: Projects portal vertices through a view matrix baked from the body camera and intersects against the parent window; drops cells if <=2 verts survive.

nodes.label: SceneTraversalBegin_SetCullCamera (0x45C150)
nodes.rationale: Sole writer of cull-camera globals (DAT_140f781d0/d4/d8). Builds view matrix and frustum planes from body position.

nodes.label: examine_portals (0x45B560)
nodes.rationale: Performs front-face filtering of outgoing portals using camera position globals.

nodes.label: PortalExpandCellPortals (0x459C10)
nodes.rationale: Performs per-cell portal expansion and front-face testing.

nodes.label: ClipAlloc (0x4600C0)
nodes.rationale: Fixed BSS array pool (20480 entries) for portal clipping; overflows cause silent portal drops.

nodes.label: Mechanism M1: Edge Popping
nodes.rationale: Objects vanish at edge of view due to 2D screen space clipping against viewport rectangle.

nodes.label: Mechanism M2: Peek/Lean Culling
nodes.rationale: Corridors don't appear when leaning because cell visibility is computed from body position, not eye position.

nodes.label: C2 Entry Bias Fix
nodes.rationale: Shifts camera position at the entry of SetCullCamera to ensure projection matrices and frustum planes are built from the eye position.

nodes.label: Cull Probe (ss2vr_cull_probe)
nodes.rationale: Instrumentation to measure geometry volume (sceneIdx/f) surviving KEX culling.

edges.rationale: Detours the entry of SetCullCamera to bias the input position struct.
Entry bias addresses M1 by ensuring the projection matrix used for object culling is eye-relative.
Entry bias addresses M2 by ensuring portal front-face tests use the eye position.
